metadata.description: SQL Server admin password. Must not contain > < | & ^ characters.
Short prefix applied to all resource names. Change this to redeploy without name conflicts.

settings.commandToExecute: [concat('cmd /c "echo ', reference(resourceId('Microsoft.Sql/servers', variables('sqlServerName'))).fullyQualifiedDomainName, ' > C:\\cfg.txt && echo ', parameters('sqlDBName'), ' >> C:\\cfg.txt && echo ', parameters('sqlAdminLogin'), ' >> C:\\cfg.txt && echo ', parameters('sqlAdminPassword'), ' >> C:\\cfg.txt && powershell -NonInteractive -EncodedCommand "')]
